meta.title: Water Intake Calculator — Daily Hydration Needs
meta.description: Calculate how much water you should drink daily based on your body weight and activity level. Stay hydrated with personalized recommendations.

howItWorks: Enter your body weight in kilograms or pounds.
Select your daily activity level from the options.
The calculator estimates your recommended daily water intake.
howToUse: Choose your activity level (sedentary, moderate, active, or intense).
View your recommended daily water intake in liters or ounces.

faq.question: How much water should I drink per day?
faq.answer: A common guideline is 2–3 liters per day, but your actual needs depend on weight, activity, climate, and health conditions. This calculator gives a personalized estimate.

faq.question: Does coffee or tea count toward water intake?
faq.answer: Yes, beverages like coffee and tea contribute to your daily fluid intake, though water is always the best choice for hydration.

faq.question: Should I drink more water when exercising?
faq.answer: Yes. You lose water through sweat during exercise. The calculator factors in your activity level to recommend additional intake.
